
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/blogray/p/22053412" title="发布于 2026-07-29 23:22">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">浙江新高一手把手教你 Python3 如何用 selenium 和 playwright 爬取 JS 动态渲染页面</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>作为浙江的新高一，即将面临严肃的住校生活。虽说杭城高中宿舍水平冠绝全国，但总是缺点什么————<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 18pt"><strong>没有乐趣！</strong></span></p>
<p><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">所以脑洞大开的我决定偷偷带 mp3 到宿舍，睡前洗澡来一曲，快乐似神仙♪٩(´ω`)و♪。然而巧妇难无米之炊，我手中的 mp3 无法连接网络，需要计算机传输音乐软件，因此需要下载大量音乐。酷狗、网易云我就不说了，下载音乐伤感情。于是我就找到了一个神仙音乐网站———— <a href="https://www.gequbao.com" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://www.xxxx.com</a>。这里有很多免费音乐可以免费下载，但是必须要等待 35s。如下</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="717" height="484" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3291804/202607/3291804-20260729214234764-669611900.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>真伤感情！于是我无奈打开了开发者工具。发现我点开音乐播放键后，Network 瞬间传过来两个文件：</p>
<p><img alt="截屏2026-07-29 22.00.48" width="1118" height="627" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3291804/202607/3291804-20260729220616839-790444672.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;有 mp3 文件！访问一下，是可以下载的。&nbsp;</p>
<p>眉头一皱，计上心来————可不可以通过监听这个请求来截获音乐 URL，以此实现音乐下载？事不宜迟，动起来吧！顺便锻炼自己爬取 JS 动态渲染页面的能力。</p>
<p>可有人访问了网站会问：为什么说是 JS 渲染的呢？audio 节点的 src不是有音乐地址吗？我们不妨做个实验：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> lxml <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> etree
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> requests
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> headers =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>     <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">User-Agent</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/150.0.0.0 Safari/537.36</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> resp = requests.get(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://www.xxxx.com/music/12764</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, headers=headers)<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">自己点击后把网站改过来，这里保护该网站</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> html =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> etree.HTML(resp.text)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> location = html.xpath(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">//audio[@id='custom-audio-player']/@src</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>

<pre class="brush:python;gutter:true;">[]

<span class="cnblogs_code_collapse">View Code</span></div>
<p>对比一下：</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="506" height="56" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3291804/202607/3291804-20260729221857726-1299590636.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image" width="504" height="44" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3291804/202607/3291804-20260729222107153-1480997761.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;什么！mp3地址消失了！我们只能解释：这个mp3资源地址是js当场渲染的。其实，requests这种低级爬虫只能得起骨架html，不可得起血肉——网站资源！</p>
<p>那么这种js渲染血肉的网站，要怎么爬取呢？</p>
<p>诶！我们可以用程序模拟浏览器访问该网页，让js渲染完后直接监听network里的mp3资源请求！这样简单高效，易于爬取。（当然你也可以在js渲染完后直接获取其填充血肉后的html，也可以达到目的，这里我的思路是监听资源请求截获其地址）。这就是selenium和playwright干的活了————模拟浏览器来应对js渲染页面。</p>
<p>因此我们可以写一个简单的程序：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> playwright.sync_api <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sync_playwright
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> requests
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> time
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> re
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> headers =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>     <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">User-Agent</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/150.0.0.0 Safari/537.36</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span>     time.sleep(1.5)<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">休息一下，速度不要太快被网页当做爬虫，为了逼真</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span>     page.click(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">text=播放</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,  timeout=5000, force=False)<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">播放音乐，让音乐文件加载</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span>     request = capture.value<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">提取请求核心信息</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">20</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(request.url)

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"><span style="caret-color: #008080">22     </span></span>with open(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{os.path.expanduser(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>~/Music/<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">)}{search}/{i}.mp3</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">wb</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>) as p:<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">大家存储地址可以改</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">23</span>         p.write(result1.content)<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">写入爬取音乐文件的具体信息</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">24</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">欧耶！</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)</pre>
</div>
<p>有几个问题：</p>
<p><strong>1、我们不是很逼真，有的时候网站怀疑我们会索要验证码，类似下方：</strong></p>
<p><img alt="download" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3291804/202607/3291804-20260729224304731-2097475121.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><strong>&nbsp;2、有的时候网站略怀疑我们，会故意“磨洋工”——js死活不加载渲染音乐的地址，压根爬不了</strong></p>
<p>这时你肯定会报playwright的timeout错误————这不是python内置的timeout错误，这是playwright独有的。</p>
<p>那我们可以异常处理，分三层：先看看能否一次成功；再看网页如果“磨洋工”就刷新一下重新加载，同时达到逼近真人的效果（真人遇到这种情况一定会刷新网页）；最后如果前面两次不成功，那一定是网站索要验证码，那我们就利用ddddocr这个库解决这种简单验证码。</p>
<p>我简单改改，顺便封装成函数形式，加上爬取歌词的功能，而且在执行前先试着用一下requests，看看网页有没有可能犯傻让我们捡便宜：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">

<p>这里base64_data = src.split(",")[1]是为了取验证码图片主要信息，舍弃头部文件属性；img_bytes是把64位图像信息格式化一下，从而直接喂ddddocr获得验证码。</p>
<p>我们补写一下其他必要的函数：</p>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    input_option.send_keys(Keys.RETURN)
    time.sleep(</span>2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">歌曲列表</span>
    list_music =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> dict()
    get_locations </span>= browser1.find_elements(By.XPATH, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">//div[@class='card-text']/div[@class='row no-gutters py-2d5 border-top align-items-center']/div[@class='col-9 col-md-8']/a</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> i <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> get_locations:
        list_music[i.get_attribute(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">title</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)] = i.get_attribute(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">href</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(list_music)
    browser1.close()
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> list_music</pre>

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> update_log(self):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">定期刷新日志显示</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        content </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.stdout_redirect.getvalue()
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> content:
            self.log_text.insert(tk.END, content)
            self.log_text.see(tk.END)
            self.stdout_redirect.truncate(0)
            self.stdout_redirect.seek(0)
        self.root.after(</span>200<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, self.update_log)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> log(self, msg):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">直接写入日志（用于非 print 信息）</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        self.log_text.insert(tk.END, msg </span>+ <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        self.log_text.see(tk.END)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> search_songs(self):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">搜索歌曲并填充列表</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        keyword </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.entry.get().strip()
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> keyword:
            messagebox.showwarning(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">提示</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">请输入搜索关键词</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        self.search_btn.config(state</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">tk.DISABLED)
        self.download_btn.config(state</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">tk.DISABLED)
        self.listbox.delete(0, tk.END)
        self.log_text.delete(</span>1.0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, tk.END)
        self.log(f</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">正在搜索：{keyword}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 后台执行搜索</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> task():
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
                self.songs_dict </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> get.search_content(keyword)
                self.keyword </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> keyword
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.songs_dict:
                    self.log(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">未找到任何歌曲</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> title <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.songs_dict.keys():
                        self.listbox.insert(tk.END, title)
                    self.log(f</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">找到 {len(self.songs_dict)} 首歌曲</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                    self.root.after(0, </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">lambda</span>: self.download_btn.config(state=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">tk.NORMAL))
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">except</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Exception as e:
                self.log(f</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">搜索出错：{e}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">finally</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
                self.root.after(0, </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">lambda</span>: self.search_btn.config(state=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">tk.NORMAL))

        threading.Thread(target</span>=task, daemon=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">True).start()

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> download_selected(self):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">下载选中的歌曲</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        selected_indices </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.listbox.curselection()
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> selected_indices:
            messagebox.showinfo(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">提示</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">请至少选择一首歌曲</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span>

        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 构建选中歌曲字典</span>
        selected_titles = [self.listbox.get(idx) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> idx <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> selected_indices]
        selected_dict </span>= {title: self.songs_dict[title] <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> title <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> selected_titles}

        self.download_btn.config(state</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">tk.DISABLED)
        self.search_btn.config(state</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">tk.DISABLED)
        self.log(f</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">开始下载 {len(selected_dict)} 首歌曲...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建文件夹（确保存在）</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            get.make_dir(self.keyword)  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 调用你的创建目录函数</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">except</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Exception as e:
            self.log(f</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">创建目录失败：{e}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 后台执行下载</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> task():
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 调用 get_music，传入选中的字典</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                get.get_music(self.keyword, selected_dict)
                self.log(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">所有选中歌曲处理完毕！</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">except</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Exception as e:
                self.log(f</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">下载过程出错：{e}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">finally</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
                self.root.after(0, </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">lambda</span>: self.download_btn.config(state=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">tk.NORMAL))
                self.root.after(0, </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">lambda</span>: self.search_btn.config(state=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">tk.NORMAL))

        threading.Thread(target</span>=task, daemon=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">True).start()

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__name__</span> == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">__main__</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:

    root.mainloop()</span></pre>
</div>
<p>好了～程序结束～，希望你可以利用这12.88kb左右的文件，下载 nGB 的音乐与歌词！希望我的高中生活在音乐沐浴中扬帆起航！</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
